observations.statement: The Yandex Games SDK provides interstitial, rewarded video and sticky banner ad units.
observations.excerpt: Interstitial ad ysdk.adv.showFullscreenAdv() Rewarded video ysdk.adv.showRewardedVideo() Sticky banner

observations.statement: Rewarded video ads on Yandex Games can be called as often as desired, while interstitial frequency is controlled by Yandex Games.
observations.excerpt: You can call rewarded video ads as often as you want. The frequency of calling an interstitial ad unit is controlled by Yandex Games .

observations.statement: Yandex recommends showing ads after a user action or on a timer if a level takes more than 5 minutes.
observations.excerpt: It is recommended to show ads after a user action or on a timer if completing a level takes more than 5 minutes.

observations.statement: Yandex treats incidental clicks on ad units as ad fraud and advises not calling ads during gameplay.
observations.excerpt: The Yandex Advertising Network considers incidental user clicks on ad units as ad fraud and reduces revenue from in-game advertising.
